# Salons Aneri (aneri.lv)

> Full-service beauty salon in Riga, Latvia (Latgales iela 264, Ķengarags). 15+ years of salon craft featuring Matrix, L'Oréal Professionnel, GLOBAL Keratin, Gelish, and PRX-T33 clinical skincare. Free private client parking right at the salon entrance.

## Appointment Booking Policy
- Appointments are booked directly with our live salon administrator by phone: `+371 27580047`.
- Automated online calendar forms are intentionally not used — call directly for personalized consultation and instant confirmation.
- Hours (Europe/Riga): Monday–Saturday 09:00–20:00, Sunday 10:00–16:00.

## Key Service Pages
- [Hair Salon in Riga (LV)](https://aneri.lv/frizetava-riga): Women's/men's/kids haircuts, Airtouch, Balayage, highlights, GLOBAL keratin.
- [Hair Salon in Riga (RU)](https://aneri.lv/ru/parikmaherskaya-riga): Стрижки, сложное окрашивание Airtouch, балаяж, кератин GLOBAL.
- [Manicure & Pedicure in Riga (LV)](https://aneri.lv/manikirs-pedikirs-riga): Gelish polish, classic manicure, hardware pedicure, men's nail care.
- [Manicure & Pedicure in Riga (RU)](https://aneri.lv/ru/manikyur-pedikyur-riga): Стойкий гель-лак Gelish, аппаратный и мужской педикюр.
- [Cosmetology & Peels (LV)](https://aneri.lv/kosmetologija-riga): Facial cleansing, PRX-T33, Cosmo Peel, Mela Peel, mesotherapy, ear piercing.
- [Cosmetology & Peels (RU)](https://aneri.lv/ru/kosmetologiya-riga): Чистка лица, пилинги PRX-T33, мезотерапия, криомассаж.
- [Permanent Makeup (LV)](https://aneri.lv/permanentais-grims-riga): Powder brows, lip blush, eyelash enhancement.
- [Waxing (LV)](https://aneri.lv/vaksacija-riga): Gentle wax depilation for face, arms, legs, bikini.
- [Vertical Solarium (LV)](https://aneri.lv/solarijs-riga): UV tanning sessions and 10-visit passes.
